• The correct spelling of the word is **Assassination**.
 
• The word **Assassination** refers to the act of killing someone, especially a prominent or important person, for political or ideological reasons.
 
• The misspelled options include:
 
 
• **Option 2: Assasination** - Missing one "s".
 
• **Option 3: Assassinaition** - Incorrect vowel placement ("ai" instead of "i").
 
• **Option 4: Assasinashion** - Incorrect spelling with "shion" instead of "tion".
 
 

**Correct sentence:** The assassination of the leader shocked the entire nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Origin:** The word "assassination" comes from "assassin," which has historical roots linked to a secretive group in the Middle Ages.
 
• **Usage:** It is commonly used in political, historical, or fictional contexts to describe the killing of a significant figure.
